header.title: UI Theme Customization
header.subtitle: Customize your LiteLLM admin dashboard with a custom logo and favicon.

logo.label: Custom Logo URL
logo.hint: Enter a URL for your custom logo or leave empty for default

logoDark.label: Custom Logo URL (dark mode)
logoDark.hint: Enter a URL for a logo suited to dark backgrounds, or leave empty to reuse the logo above

favicon.label: Custom Favicon URL
favicon.hint: Enter a URL for your custom favicon (.ico, .png, or .svg) or leave empty for default
